scope.name: New Territories East
scope.networkBoundary: Official DCCA union plus declared context buffer

graph.routingMethod: A* over complete enabled directed New Territories East 3DPN subset
graph.selectionMethod: Edge midpoint inside 107 official 2019 DCCAs or their 600 m context buffer

fallbackPolicy.eligibility: Census-populated DCCA with zero positive-evidence anchors; active unnamed Tower only, with no OP non-residential evidence, no negative name evidence and no BuildingName-table record.
fallbackPolicy.interpretation: Routeable home candidates only. The fallback does not establish residential use or observed child occupancy and remains excluded from positive-evidence counts.

residentialBuildingAudit.classificationPolicy: Positive CSDI OP domestic GFA/type or explicit residential building-name evidence; only explicitly listed DCCAs may use a separately labelled Census-backed unnamed-tower fallback

attachments.runtimeHomeMethod: Synthetic homes sample positive-evidence CSDI residential building anchors inside the target DCCAs and attach to primary component 0

source.dataset: Hong Kong Lands Department 3D Pedestrian Network Phase 2

regionalPopulationEvidence.method: 2021 Census DCCA age-band proxy restricted to model ages 6-16

runtime.loadMode: bounded parallel fetch followed by typed-array CSR assembly
runtime.pathCache: Scenario, heat coefficient and OD keyed least-recent insertion cache

supported: All selected New Territories East 3DPN nodes and edges are retained in compressed chunks
Chunk boundaries preserve global graph topology
Target-DCCA school and child POI endpoints are snapped to the primary routable component
Synthetic homes use official CSDI building positions with positive residential-use evidence
Walking trips use an actual directed 3DPN origin-destination A* path
limitations: Household membership and home assignment are synthetic; no observed child address is used
A straight connector links each place coordinate to its snapped 3DPN node
Endpoints beyond the declared maximum primary-component snap distance are audited and excluded
AccessTime records are retained by ID but temporal opening restrictions are not yet evaluated
Network edges outside the declared DCCA union and context buffer are not included
A regional stress graph is evidence for reusable expansion, not a claim of simultaneous whole-Hong-Kong behavioural simulation

acceptanceGates: The four frozen District names resolve to exactly 107 official 2019 DCCAs
Every target DCCA is audited for official 3DPN edges and evidence-backed residential anchors; any gap or fallback is explicitly enumerated
All released school, child POI and residential endpoints attach to the declared primary routable component
Dense shared node IDs preserve physical topology across 2 km chunk boundaries
Exact directed 3D A* is tested across adjoining land-connected Districts and representative terrain-sensitive ODs
A Census-weighted 2,000-Agent population covers every supported DCCA-age stratum without turning weights into crowding or contact inputs
Browser loading, memory and route latency remain bounded on the local reference computer
Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and V12.9.5 linked-selection regressions remain passing

claimBoundary.supported: The 107 official 2019 DCCAs in Sha Tin, Tai Po, North and Sai Kung are audited against a compressed official 3D pedestrian graph with real endpoint attachments and exact directed walking A* where the source topology is connected.
claimBoundary.notSupported: V12.10 does not claim that every pair of DCCAs is mutually walkable, that mechanised New Territories trips follow operator services, that synthetic homes are observed households, or that MVPA, crowding and contact are externally validated.
